question: The Phase-I programme of 'Sagar Parikrama' has been organized in Gujarat, started on 5th March, 2022 from ______.
solution:
The correct answer is Mandvi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first leg will begin on March 5 in **Mandvi **and end on March 6 in **Porbandar, Gujarat.**
 
• On March 5, 2022, **Gujarat** will welcome the "**Sagar Parikrama**" under the auspices of **Union Minister Parshottam Rupala.**
 
• The **Gujarat Maritime Board, Indian Coast Guard, Fishery Survey of India, Department of Fisheries**, and fisherman representatives are all involved in organising it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sagar Parikrama**

 
 
• ​ It is a **navigation journey **that will be undertaken in all **coastal states and UTs **along a previously chosen maritime route to show support for all fishermen, fish producers, and other interested parties.
 
• It is intended to be a component of "**Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsava,**" which honours our outstanding liberation fighters, sailors, and fishermen.
 
• In order to understand the issues facing coastal fishermen, it will also run interaction programmes with fishermen, fisher communities, and stakeholders in these places and districts.
 
• It is envisioned in the sea along the coastal belt to show support for all fishermen, fish producers, and other interested parties in the **Atma Nirbhar Bharat spirit.**
